column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: one subtest per dialect, so mysql and mssql skip in this PostgreSQL-only job while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set (skipped: /mysql, /mssql). Guards cleat#1965's bare-key mutex arm the same way its registered-queue sibling test guards the registered arm; the mssql subtest is the one that caught a genuine dialect-specific bug in the fix (a hand-written INSERT ... WHERE NOT EXISTS pre-check that still tested expires_at, throwing a raw PRIMARY KEY violation instead of a graceful refusal).

dialect-gated per SUBTEST: same test, same two arms, and the cluster job runs ./engine/... too, so these lines move together. Same measurement and reason as the test-go/engine line above; see cleat#1965.
